_meta.description: Per-holdco mapping to the underlying listed operating businesses whose value drives the holdco NAV. Used by the analysis page to surface 'Underlying holdings' in place of a peer cohort for pure holding companies (DCF on the holdco itself is meaningless — SOTP on the underlying is the right framework). Tickers are NSE bare symbols (no .NS suffix). Empty list = constituents are unlisted / private (still classified as holdco; just no link-out is provided).
_meta.source: NSE filings + financial press coverage of pure investment companies (2026-06-09).
caveats: The list is not exhaustive — promoter group cross-holdings and small unlisted stakes are intentionally omitted to keep the surface focused on what a retail user can themselves analyze.
When a holdco's primary underlying is itself unlisted, the array is empty rather than seeded with a parent group name — emitting an unlisted symbol would break the link-out.
Maintained in sync with backend/services/analysis/constants.py::HOLDING_COMPANIES — every key here MUST also be in HOLDING_COMPANIES (test guards this).
